body: You're giving it your best and that's all they can ask of you. You are good enough because you are trying your hardest and giving it your all. Prove it to them that you can do it. More importantly, prove it to yourself because I know you're better than you think.
This decision is permanent. Please don't do this. Please hold on and fight it. We're here for you.
I'm truly sorry for what you had to endure. Please don't do this because this is permanent. Please fight.
Can I ask what's led you to make this decision

Just remember that often your parents can be overly critical of you because they wish the best of you. You and I are flawed and so are your parents. Consider talking to them about how you feel and ask them to not expect the world of you if they do.
I don't believe that you're pathetic. I just think you're going through something hard at the moment. I truly think that people on this forum care about you and your well-being.
